title: Undo the Tape
lines: Gran sent Ben a box with a lock.
Ben was unhappy. He had no way in.
He sat and gave the lock a tug.
Mom said, "Undo the tape on the back."
Ben did. The back of the box slid off.
Inside he found a red kite and a note.
Ben did not need to unlock it at all.

questions.ask: Why was Ben unhappy at the start?
questions.listenFor: The box had a lock and he had no way in. Let them reread line two if they are not sure.
A red kite and a note. If they only say the kite, ask what else.

questions.ask: What do you think the note said? Why do you think that?
questions.listenFor: Anything is fine here - the story does not say. You want a guess with a reason behind it.
